comment: Knowledge-graph usefulness probes. search: query must surface one of `expect` in the top 3. neighbors: traversal from `seed` must return every id in `expectMin`. Grow this file whenever a real question the graph failed to answer comes up.

search.q: how does work survive a kill -9 in the middle of a step
search.why: durability without the word durable — the vocabulary an agent actually uses

search.q: which package is every other one allowed to import
search.why: the tier rule stated as a question, not as its name

search.q: the fence that stops a step writing outside the globs it declared
search.why: user remembers the mechanism, not the term 'zone'

search.q: where does an agent record a finding so the next run reuses it
search.why: describes the purpose of the memory graph without naming it

search.q: how does an approved plan become durable running work
search.why: approval lives in the kernel, execution in the runtime; one note cannot answer it
there is no kubernetes anything here; a confident hit is a confident lie
the queue is DBOS over Postgres; kafka appears nowhere

single-character identifier query, the regression class 56b84be fixed ('memory search x' returning nothing); VERIFIED hit — area-ui's body names the x-orc-token/x-orc-project headers, and SurrealDB's analyzer splits that hyphenated token so a lone 'x' matches it (keyword@1, semantic 0-result, fused@1)
single real-word token with no natural-language padding; VERIFIED hit@1 in all three modes

single identifier token naming a real symbol (rank.ts); VERIFIED the semantic arm returns ZERO results for it (an identifier has no natural-language meaning to embed), so only the keyword arm carries this hit and fusion has to inherit it rather than compute it — the exact 'arm carries what fused would lose without it' shape this file now tracks

1-token negative, shorter than every prior negative (4-5 tokens); VERIFIED the keyword arm stays correctly silent but the semantic floor answers confidently anyway (area-kernel etc.) — SEMANTIC_FLOOR's own comment names this as a floor, not a separator, and this probe is that limitation with a real 1-token query

2-token negative built to trip meetsQuorum's documented limitation (a 2-term query passes on 1 match): VERIFIED 'cli' alone clears quorum against area-cli/step-map-cli even though 'stripe' matches nothing in the corpus, so every arm answers confidently wrong

matchesRow-filtered probe (matchesRow was new shared code with no benchmark coverage): unfiltered, this query's top-1 is area-memory with target-memory-lifecycle ranked 2nd; VERIFIED category=target narrows the corpus to the one target-tier note and gets the right one at @1 in all three modes

claims.why: identifier query graded against searchClaims (previously ungraded entirely); VERIFIED hit@1 in all three modes — packages/contracts/src/workspace.ts's assertInZone is a sourced claim on zone-write-fence
multi-token query naming an identifier; VERIFIED hit@1 in all three modes on a claim naming rank.ts's rankNeighbors/rrfFuse

the same quorum-limitation query as the note-level negative above, run through searchClaims; VERIFIED it answers confidently wrong here too (area-cli et al.) — the keyword rewrite's claim-arm zero-result number (16/20->8/20, keyword.ts) was never checked against top-k quality, and this is why

neighbors.why: tier rule as edges: who imports contracts
hub decomposition; spread>0 proves edges are typed, not a flat star
target/deferred work reachable from its current-state note
